Added explicit yuv444p before zoompan to remove subsampled crop-position rounding, then convert to output yuv420p afterward. Local 12s probe passed at <=0.637px without relaxing tolerance. All representative final renders are rerun; initial exports/receipts retained separately.

The fixture builder now assigns the terminal boundary to exact authoritative project duration. Before-clamp manifests retained; output/frame quantization/transition tolerance unchanged.

first_failure_runner: Corrupt WAV correctly raised wave.Error; the failure harness originally did not classify that exception. Added wave.Error/EOFError as rejection evidence rather than changing media validation.
first_visual_marker_check: The validator sampled x=100,y=100, which is the fixture's white border rather than its background marker.
